Advisor.title: 유사투자자문사
Advisor.notice: 출처: 금융감독원 '파인'(매일 갱신). <s>'신고'는 안전 보증·인증이 아닙니다.</s> 트릴리언은 안전성·수익성을 보증하지 않고 사실만 제공합니다. 신고 안 된 익명 리딩방은 특히 주의.
Advisor.noSearchResult: 검색 결과가 없습니다. 신고되지 않은 업체일 수 있으니 주의하세요.
Advisor.noVerifiedDesc: 본인 리딩방이세요? 금감원 유사투자자문 신고 + 운영자 인증을 마치면 무료로 게재돼요.
Advisor.previewEmpty:
왼쪽에서 리딩방을 선택하면

여기에 금감원 정보가 표시됩니다.
Advisor.publicLinkNote: 금감원 신고 시 제출된 공개 링크 · 미인증
Advisor.reportDoneDesc: 확인 후 필요 시 금융감독원에 전달됩니다.
Advisor.reportGuide: 신고는 접수 후 관리자 검토를 거쳐 공개에 반영됩니다. 허위 신고는 무고가 될 수 있으니 사실에 근거해 작성해주세요.

Business.title: 리딩방 등록·관리
Business.desc: 금감원에 유사투자자문 신고된 업체만 게재할 수 있어요. 본인 업체를 인증하면, 관리자 확인 후 직접 리딩방·채널 링크를 관리할 수 있습니다.
Business.claimDoneDesc:
국세청 진위확인 통과 + 서류 제출 완료. 관리자 최종 확인 후 게재됩니다.

보통 영업일 기준 1~2일 내 처리됩니다.
Business.notFound: 금감원 신고 명부에서 못 찾았어요. 신고된 업체만 게재할 수 있습니다.
Business.askOwnerDesc: 개업일자로 국세청 진위확인을 거치고, 사업자등록증을 첨부하면 관리자 확인 후 게재됩니다. 허위 신청은 제재될 수 있어요.
Business.noBiz: 아직 인증한 업체가 없어요. 위 업체 인증 탭에서 본인 업체를 찾아 인증하세요.
Business.manageDesc: 금감원 신고 정보는 자동 표시되며 수정할 수 없어요. 소개·링크·관리자만 관리할 수 있어요.
Business.fssNote: 위 정보는 금감원 신고 데이터라 수정할 수 없어요. 사용자에게 이 모습 그대로 표시됩니다.
Business.noChannels: 아직 등록한 채널이 없어요. 무료 채널 1개를 등록하면 인증 리딩방에 노출돼요.
Business.paidNote: 추가 채널은 채널당 월 5만원이에요. 결제 기능 준비 중 — 결제하면 자동 게재, 미결제 시 자동 비공개됩니다.
Business.mgrNote: 공유받은 사람도 이 업체의 소개·링크를 관리할 수 있어요(가입 계정 필요).

Footer.disclaimer2: 트릴리언의 ‘신고’·평가·인증 표시는 사실 제공을 위한 것이며, 대상의 안전성·수익성을 보증하지 않습니다. 신고되지 않은 익명 리딩방은 특히 주의하시기 바랍니다.

Advertise.rule2: 유사투자자문 신고 + 운영자 인증을 마친 곳만 유료 광고가 가능합니다.

Advisor.title: Investment advisory firms
Advisor.notice: Source: the “FINE” service of the Financial Supervisory Service (updated daily). <s>A filing is not a guarantee of safety, nor a certification.</s> Trillion does not guarantee safety or profitability; it provides facts only. Take particular care with anonymous, unfiled advisory rooms.
Advisor.search: Search every room name, firm name, and representative
Advisor.noSearchResult: No results. The firm may not have filed, so take care.
Advisor.noVerifiedDesc: Is this your room? Complete the FSS investment advisory filing and operator verification to be listed for free.
Advisor.previewEmpty:
Select an advisory room on the left

and its FSS details appear here.
Advisor.publicLinkNote: Public link submitted with the FSS filing · unverified
Advisor.reportDoneDesc: We will review it and pass it to the Financial Supervisory Service if needed.
Advisor.reportPlaceholder: Describe the harm and the circumstances in detail.
Advisor.reportGuide: Reports are reviewed by an admin before they affect what is shown publicly. A false report can amount to defamation, so please base it on facts.

Business.title: Advisory room registration · management
Business.desc: Only firms that have filed as an investment advisory business with the FSS can be listed. Verify your firm and, after an admin check, you can manage your advisory room and channel links directly.
Business.errStartDt: Enter the business start date in YYYYMMDD format (8 digits).
Business.errFile: Please attach your business registration certificate.
Business.errContact: Please enter a contact for the person in charge.
Business.claimDone: Your verification request has been received.
Business.claimDoneDesc:
The NTS authenticity check passed and your documents were submitted. It will be listed after a final admin check.

This usually takes 1 to 2 business days.
Business.searchPh: Search by firm name or business registration number
Business.notFound: Not found in the FSS filing register. Only filed firms can be listed.
Business.askOwner: Are you the representative or manager of {name}?
Business.askOwnerDesc: Pass the NTS authenticity check with your business start date and attach your business registration certificate; you will be listed after an admin check. False requests may be penalized.
Business.startDtLabel: Business start date (as printed on the registration certificate)
Business.fileLabel: Business registration certificate (or proof of representation)
Business.contactPh: Contact for the person in charge (phone or email)
Business.noBiz: You have not verified a firm yet. Find yours in the Verify firm tab above.
Business.manageDesc: FSS filing details are shown automatically and cannot be edited. You can manage only the intro, links, and managers.
Business.errLinkUrl: Enter a link address starting with http.
Business.fssNote: The details above come from FSS filing data and cannot be edited. Users see them exactly as shown.
Business.introPh: One-line intro for the firm or advisory room
Business.channelsBadge: Shown under Advisory rooms · verification > Verified rooms
Business.noChannels: No channels registered yet. Register one free channel to appear under Verified rooms.
Business.paidNote: Additional channels are ₩50,000 per channel per month. Payment is coming soon — once paid, listing is automatic; unpaid channels are hidden automatically.
Business.mgrPh: Sign-up email of the person to share with
Business.mgrNote: The person you share with can also manage the intro and links for this firm (a sign-up account is required).

Favorites.loginForRooms: Sign in to collect advisory rooms here.
Favorites.emptyRooms: Tap ⭐ under Advisory rooms · verification and they gather here.

Footer.disclaimer2: The “filing”, rating, and verification markers shown on Trillion exist to provide facts. They do not guarantee the safety or profitability of their subject. Take particular care with anonymous, unfiled advisory rooms.

Advertise.rule2: Only firms that have filed as an investment advisory business and completed operator verification may buy advertising.
